decision: User decision 2026-10-16 after dig2 round 2: drop network_lr_horizon_cap from the selected K3P and KA2 recipes. With the cap their G/D LR reached its 0.01 floor at update 1,600 and was the only reason they failed ring16_acquisition_6400; with it removed and nothing else changed both passed (diagnostic D1, reports/forge/dig2-20261016/ring16-cap.md).
pin_rule: configs/forge/selections/family-current-v1.json keeps its exact measured pins until a revision below is measured on the current view; the publication then replaces that family's pin with the measured row of the declared candidate (never with the superseded one) and archives the old pin. Superseded recipes stay declared.
